svg.title: Equilibria of a bistable cubic by vectorized pseudo-transient solves
svg.desc: A diagram of equilibrium x against a forcing parameter a: an upper and a lower branch of stable states from the vectorized solves, a dashed unstable branch from the cubic's roots, and a bounded shaded interval of a in which both stable states exist.
